## Common small scene bundle layout
All menu/ref/level packs below share the same file types:
- Textures: .pct + .pct_header (paired).
- Scene data: .stg + .bin.
- Root files: .load_list + .desc_block.

Totals vary by number of texture pairs:
- Total 16 = 6 texture pairs (12 texture files) + 2 scene files + 2 root files.
- Total 18 = 7 texture pairs (14 texture files) + 2 scene files + 2 root files.
